description.value: The Red Wagon Cafe is a brunch and diner-style cafe on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's east side, offering indoor seating in a neighbourhood restaurant setting. Based on OSM tags it serves brunch, diner, and cafe cuisine with no outdoor seating. Domain hijacking on the listed website means current operating status cannot be verified.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a brunch/diner/cafe restaurant at 2128 East Hastings Street, Vancouver. However, the website fetched from https://www.redwagoncafe.com/ is entirely unrelated content — an Indonesian gambling/gaming news site called 'WagonNews' — indicating the original domain has expired and been hijacked. Because the website content is irrelevant to this business, no amenity claims can be confirmed from it; all amenity fields default to null except where OSM tags provide some signal (internet_access=wlan, indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=no). The domain hijacking raises serious doubts about whether the business is still operating.
concerns: DOMAIN HIJACKED: https://www.redwagoncafe.com/ now resolves to 'WagonNews', an Indonesian gambling/gaming spam site — the original cafe's website content is gone.
Business may be permanently closed; domain expiry and hijacking is a common post-closure pattern.
OSM tag 'takeaway:covid19=only' is a stale COVID-era tag and does not reflect current operations.
No amenity claims (Wi-Fi, takeout, washrooms, bike parking, etc.) could be verified due to domain hijacking; all depend on manual review.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The listed website domain (redwagoncafe.com) has been hijacked and now hosts an entirely unrelated Indonesian gambling site ('WagonNews'), which is a strong indicator the business has closed and the domain has lapsed. Operating status cannot be confirmed without an independent check.
enrichment_extras.notes: If the business is still operating, the website URL in OSM must be updated and all amenity fields re-evaluated. A manual visit or phone call is recommended before including in the directory.
